_comment: Copy to docs-sync/config.json and edit. Drives scripts/collect-doc-changes.mjs, scripts/extract-symbols.mjs, and the /update-docs command. The live config.json is gitignored.
_branches_comment: Empty = update docs on every branch push. Restrict to specific branches e.g. ['main', 'staging'].

docs._comment: output_dir: the living-docs folder (only files here are ever edited). changelog: the append-only file.

external_docs._comment_1: For projects whose docs live OUTSIDE the repo (Notion, Confluence, GitBook, ReadMe, a wiki, a plain URL). On the first interactive /update-docs run, if the project has no in-repo docs, the operator is asked whether docs live elsewhere; a link given here is recorded in docs/README.md and used below.
external_docs._comment_2: provider: notion|confluence|gitbook|readme|wiki|url|null. url: the link. prompted: set true once asked so it never re-prompts. Leave url null to have docs generated in-repo instead.

sections._comment: Toggle each surface. A section regenerates only when its bucket in the change-report is non-empty.

generation._comment: auto_doc_markers: wrap generated blocks in <!-- AUTO-DOC:START ... --> so hand-written prose is never clobbered. use_ast: allow ast-grep-based extraction.

llm_narration._comment: When true, /update-docs writes the 'why/impact' prose outside the markers, grounded in the diff. When false, only deterministic inventories + changelog are produced.

symbol_reference._comment_1: The module + function-level reference (TypeDoc/pydoc-style). Whole-repo backfill, then incremental: only symbols whose bodyHash changed get re-described.
symbol_reference._comment_2: max_new_per_run caps LLM cost on the first (backfill) pass so it can span several PRs. include/exclude are globs; tests/vendor/node_modules/migrations are excluded by default.

mappings._comment: Optional per-framework overrides for where backend/schema/frontend code lives. Omit to use the built-in DEFAULT_MAPPINGS. Keys: python|node|nextjs|nestjs|django-react, each with backend/schema/frontend glob arrays.
